description: List TC39 proposals from a parsed proposals index sourced via the loader chain (local cache → hosted Worker → bundled fallback); the index is fetched on first use and cached locally. Filter by `stage` ('0'|'1'|'2'|'2.7'|'3'|'finished'|'inactive'|'active'), `champion` (substring), or `contains` (name/slug substring). Returns lightweight rows; follow up with `proposal.get`. No auth, no subprocess.

champion.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on the champion list.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter applied to the proposal name + slug.

limit.description: Max proposals returned from the filtered set.

spec.description: Filter to one spec's proposals: '262' (core language) or '402' (Intl). tc39/proposals tracks the two in parallel — omit to list both.

stage.description: Filter to one stage: '0', '1', '2', '2.7', '3', 'finished', 'inactive', or 'active' (anything in the active README — stages 2/2.7/3).

name: proposal.list
title: List TC39 proposals
